description.value: Big Star Sandwich Co. is a Lower Mainland sandwich chain founded in 2013, now operating six locations including this Langley outpost. Sandwiches are built on fresh-baked filone bread with meats cooked in-house — beef slow-roasted overnight for 13 hours, hand-pulled turkey breast, and authentically prepared corned beef. Catering is available for groups, and a loyalty rewards program makes it a worthwhile repeat stop on a multi-day tour through the Fraser Valley.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, actively operating sandwich chain with a confirmed Langley location; a solid hearty-meal stop for touring cyclists on the Fraser Valley corridor.
